status: Audit proposal only; not an approved training taxonomy
notes: The proposed acne class combines two source label names; confirm the grouping before preparing training labels.
Do not silently include dyshidrotic eczema, contact dermatitis, pustular psoriasis, acneiform eruption or urticaria pigmentosa.
SCIN weights are differential-label ranking weights, not calibrated disease probabilities.
The screen is a sensitivity analysis, not confirmation of diagnosis, image quality, image availability or independence.
